subject.title: feat(plugins): allow per-turn tool narrowing in prompt hooks

question: Should OpenClaw commit to `before_prompt_build.toolsAllow` as a supported public plugin API, including its narrowing-only and multi-plugin intersection semantics?
rationale: This is not only an internal wiring fix: it adds a new externally consumable hook field whose long-term semantics, supported runtimes, and compatibility promise need owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded hook API
options.body: Approve the narrowing-only `toolsAllow` contract after the compile blocker is fixed and require tests and documentation for all supported harnesses.

options.title: Keep the capability internal
options.body: Do not expose the field through the plugin hook until a narrower owner-approved API boundary is designed.

options.title: Defer for API design
options.body: Pause the PR while owners decide whether per-turn tool restriction belongs in this hook or a dedicated tool-policy hook.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded hook API
recommendation.body: Approve the narrowing-only `toolsAllow` contract after the compile blocker is fixed and require tests and documentation for all supported harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: Kaspre is the strongest available low-confidence routing candidate for the current plugin-hook area.
